assignment_scope: Design-only first wave; own-work hand-case probe is not a production-instrument mutation or independent final falsifier.
defect: Parse the input before substitution and replace only string leaves whose immediate field name is start_url, reference_url or url. This drops serialized-text replacements in other fields, including unread annotation metadata.
detector_contract: Compare the complete projected task object with the separately written literal expectation; check all three changed-leaf paths, four raw occurrences, zero remaining six-known-token occurrences, unchanged public reference answers and preserved runtime markers. Compare the same immutable fixture and expectation for pristine, mutated and restored candidate bytes.
fixture_provenance: Retains raw task66 task_id, start_url token, both public reference-answer strings, eval_types, blank reference_url, empty program_html and two-token reference_answer_raw_annotation. Replaces intent with explicit synthetic non-URL token-bearing text; adds fixture_markers; omits other raw fields. This is not an exact task66 copy or benchmark validity observation.
interpretation_boundary: The source-selected string_match must_include branch does not read reference_answer_raw_annotation. Its generated value must still change because the upstream generator replaces the whole serialized input. No scorer outcome, browser, helper, deployment or 812-by-3 coverage claim follows from this hand case.
decision_rule: A baseline failure is inconclusive. Mark only the own-work demonstration killed if pristine exits0, this one-line mutant exits1 at the specified non-URL/annotation paths while its URL control passes, and exact restored bytes exit0. Production mutation status remains NOT_RUN. A future production surviving mutant is a coverage finding, not permission to discard metadata.
restoration_requirement: Restore exactly the pristine candidate bytes even on detector failure; record candidate SHA-256 before mutation, during mutation and after restoration, plus fixture/expectation/detector hashes.
